ruleDefinitions.name: Wab/Wabmig Unusual Parent Or Child Processes
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects unusual parent or children of the wab.exe (Windows Contacts) and Wabmig.exe (Microsoft Address Book Import Tool) processes as seen being used with bumblebee activity

sequences.query: (((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\WmiPrvSE\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\dllhost\\\.exe$")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\wab\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wabmig\\\.exe$"))) OR (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wab\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wabmig\\\.exe$")))
